critical_code_review_comments: server.py _kpi_block (line ~3413) correctly falls back to _sum_sales(rows) when /kpis empty — preserves legacy behaviour and prevents NaN blow-up for very-low-traffic windows.

_HEAVY_LIMITS bump from 1→2 plus 8s acquire timeout is well-reasoned (comments at lines 256-275 capture rationale); _repl_inflight dedupes same-key callers, so identical concurrent requests still share compute regardless of limit.
Replenishments.jsx todayEat/yesterdayEat memos use UTC+3 offset — correct for EAT but will fail if Kenya ever observes DST. Not a real risk (Kenya has no DST), document only.
Header h2 includes the sub-pill span inside the same heading element. Screen-reader-friendly but the span uses normal-case + smaller font so visual hierarchy is preserved. Good.
